newsitem.title: USA: US donates 11,525 tns food to ex-Soviet Republics.
newsitem.headline: US donates 11,525 tns food to ex-Soviet Republics.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department said Wednesday that it is donating 11,525 tonnes of rice, wheat flour, vegetable oil and other food stuffs to five former Soviet republics.
The largest donation is to Kyrgyzstan, which will receive 3,000 tonnnes of rice, vegetable oil and wheat flour for distribution to infants and children under treatment for blood diseases.
--2,500 tonnes of rice, vegetable oil and bulgur wheat to Armenia also for distribution to children suffering from blood diseases;
--2,225 tonnes of rice, beans, vegetable oils and wheat flour to vunerable groups in Georgia;
--2,000 tonnes of rice, dry whole milk and wheat flour for hospitals, orphanages, kindergartens and other institutions in Moldova; and
--1,800 tonnes of rice, dry whole milk, wheat flour, and vegetable oil to hospitals, orphanages, kindergartens and other institutions in Ukraine.
In each, the food will be distributed through a private voluntary organization working with USDA. The supply period for the donations is fiscal 1997, which ends September 30.
